description: This file provides utility functions for managing application state via localStorage, including persisting and retrieving user progress, vocabulary statistics, and quiz results, with a focus on a namespace 'llh'.

methods.name: loadState(key, defaultValue)
methods.description: Safely loads and parses persisted state from localStorage with a specified namespace key, returning a default value if none exists or an error occurs.

methods.name: saveState(key, value)
methods.description: Persists a given value to localStorage under a namespaced key, converting to JSON, and quietly ignoring quota errors.

methods.name: getProgressForLesson(id)
methods.description: Retrieves progress (0..1) for a specific lesson by its ID, defaulting to 0 if not set.

methods.name: setProgressForLesson(id, value)
methods.description: Stores progress (clamped between 0 and 1) for a specific lesson ID.

methods.name: getVocabStats()
methods.description: Retrieves vocabulary statistics, namely counts of known and unknown words.

methods.name: updateVocabStats(deltaKnown = 0, deltaUnknown = 0)
methods.description: Updates vocabulary counts by provided deltas, ensuring counts do not go negative, and saves the new stats.

methods.name: getLastQuizResult()
methods.description: Retrieves the last quiz result with total, correct answers, and timestamp.

methods.name: setLastQuizResult(result)
methods.description: Stores the quiz result along with the current timestamp.
